title: Concept: OS command execution via Runtime.getRuntime().exec(payload) (java) — review required
description: In java, Runtime.getRuntime().exec(payload) executes operating-system commands. The weakness mechanics are identical across languages — shell metacharacters in untrusted input break out of the intended command — but the concrete sink spelling, argument conventions, and safe alternative (ProcessBuilder with a command list) are java-specific.
applicability: java codebases that launch external processes through Runtime.getRuntime().exec(payload); single-line lexical scope.
risk: Unauthenticated command execution when untrusted input reaches the sink; HIGH severity because exploitation is typically trivial and impact is full process compromise.
